CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_attachment_metadata_path_matches_v2(p_storage_path text, p_record_type text, p_data_environment text, p_record_no text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with path_parts as (
    select storage.foldername(p_storage_path) as parts
  )
  select
    p_storage_path is not null
    and p_storage_path <> ''
    and p_record_type = any(array[
      'draft_requests', 'expense_requests', 'invoices', 'vouchers', 'bills'
    ])
    and p_data_environment = any(array['production', 'test'])
    and nullif(p_record_no, '') is not null
    and (
      (
        (parts)[1] = p_record_type
        and (parts)[2] = p_data_environment
        and (parts)[7] = p_record_no
      )
      or (
        (parts)[1] = public.current_tenant_id()::text
        and (parts)[2] = p_record_type
        and (parts)[3] = p_data_environment
        and (parts)[8] = p_record_no
      )
    )
  from path_parts
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_can_insert_attachment_metadata_v2(p_attachment file_attachments)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    auth.uid() is not null
    and nullif(public.current_finance_user_id(), '') is not null
    and nullif(public.finance_current_verified_google_email_v2(), '')
          is not null
    and p_attachment.tenant_id = public.current_tenant_id()
    and p_attachment.bucket_id = 'finance-attachments'
    and p_attachment.uploaded_by = public.current_finance_user_id()
    and p_attachment.attachment_state = 'staged'
    and p_attachment.staged_at is not null
    and p_attachment.claimed_at is null
    and p_attachment.record_type = any(array[
      'draft_requests',
      'expense_requests',
      'invoices',
      'vouchers',
      'bills'
    ])
    and p_attachment.data_environment = any(array['production', 'test'])
    and public.finance_attachment_metadata_path_matches_v2(
      p_attachment.storage_path,
      p_attachment.record_type,
      p_attachment.data_environment,
      p_attachment.record_no
    )
    and exists (
      select 1
      from storage.objects object_row
      where object_row.bucket_id = p_attachment.bucket_id
        and object_row.name = p_attachment.storage_path
        and object_row.owner_id = auth.uid()::text
    )
$function$
